serving.name: Neat
serving.recommendation: Preferred way to evaluate the long pepper, citrus and mint finish at 112.6 proof.

serving.name: Rocks
serving.recommendation: Add a few drops rather than a large cube first; high proof can support some dilution.

serving.name: Old Fashioned
serving.recommendation: Use a notably light sugar dose to avoid wasting layered aged rye.

serving.name: Manhattan
serving.recommendation: A spirit-forward Manhattan works; choose vermouth that does not overwhelm citrus and oak.

serving.name: Highball
serving.recommendation: A tall rye highball is plausible, but this relatively mature/limited bottle is most informative neat before mixing.
